source.name: Agent2Agent Protocol v1.0.1
normative_notes: AgentCard endpoint fields live under supportedInterfaces[].
AgentCard version is the card/service contract version; supportedInterfaces[].protocolVersion is the A2A protocol version.
SendMessageConfiguration.returnImmediately false or absent waits until terminal or interrupted task state.
Task states are protocol enum strings such as TASK_STATE_WORKING and TASK_STATE_FAILED.
Gateway ingress fixtures are strict A2A v1.0; pre-1.0 slash method aliases are not accepted unless a later compatibility mode is explicitly specified.
